scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.push:staging: npm run build && node scripts/assemble.mjs staging staff && node scripts/assemble.mjs staging verify && (cd deploy/staging/staff && clasp push --force) && (cd deploy/staging/verify && clasp push --force)
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run push:staging && node scripts/deploy.mjs staging staff && node scripts/deploy.mjs staging verify
scripts.push:production: npm run build && node scripts/assemble.mjs production staff && node scripts/assemble.mjs production verify && (cd deploy/production/staff && clasp push --force) && (cd deploy/production/verify && clasp push --force)
scripts.deploy:production: npm run push:production && node scripts/deploy.mjs production staff && node scripts/deploy.mjs production verify
